admission.justification: The public producer, file storage, lifecycle or native transport owners must preserve this same boundary across their distinct source locations.

applicability: role_message wait results whose final reply exceeds the effective character limit.
conditions: The bridge exposes the complete final text to policy.
exclusions: Developer chat text and native host chat display
Messages via removed earlier orchestration tools
A filing failure explicitly reports truncation and warning instead of claiming retained whole text.

evidence: Long-wait-reply cut+file cases in mcp/tests/test_paseo_role_messages.py and whole-reply bridge test; checks-attempt4/pytest-focused.log; worker report Attempt 4

statement: A wait reply over the limit is filed whole as recipient to sender while the answer carries the cut plus the file line; the bridge returns the whole reply and cuts nothing itself.
